text: This sample template is designed to assist the user in performing a Business Impact Analysis (BIA) on an information system.  The template is meant only as a basic guide and may not apply equally to all systems.  The user may modify this template or the general BIA approach as required to best accommodate the specific system.  In this template, words in italics are for guidance only and should be deleted from the final version.  Regular (non-italic) text is intended to remain.
